source: CMaNGOS classic-db (github.com/cmangos/classic-db, classicdb.sql, GPL-3.0): emulator world database for 1.12. Quests that ask for an item dropped in AQ20 or AQ40, and the items involved (with every Molten Core, AQ20 and AQ40 drop). stats are {stat type, value}; spells are {spell id, trigger} (1 = on equip); fit is the item as ItemFit sees it (slot, class, subclass, stats).
